update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.57 - Running-style aptitudes, outfit growth-rate bonuses, tunable legacy-parent weights
New --- - The game-data scraper now also captures Front/Pace/Late/End running-style aptitudes from GameTora's character pages, and the bot seeds each Trainee's running-style aptitudes from the selected Smart Race Solver character preset at career start instead of leaving them all-G until OCR'd mid-run, fixing a silent early-run bias toward Front Runner in skill evaluation and training stat bias. - Outfit/costume variants (e.g. "Special Week (Wedding)") now get their own character preset entry carrying a per-stat growth-rate bonus, which the Smart Race Solver factors into race scoring via a distance-type stat split heuristic. - Added an Oguri Cap (Christmas) outfit preset (+15% Speed/Stamina growth) and a matching high-rank training profile (Settings → Import settings → oguri-cap-christmas-high-rank.json). - StatAndAptitude legacy-parent scoring weights are now tunable instead of hardcoded.
